note: Claude's next upgrade ideas, shown in the app (🤖 Claude > 💡 Ideas, or ask the chat "give me ideas"). 👍 Do it turns one into a request. Claude keeps this list fresh: take out what was built, add new ones. Plain words, no tenant data.

ideas.title: Quiet hours for alerts
ideas.why: No phone alerts after 9 PM or before 7 AM, except 24-hour notices and emergencies.

ideas.title: The chat remembers what you tell it
ideas.why: Say "remember the super at 123 Main is in the basement" and it tells you next time you go there. Kept on your phone only.

ideas.title: Next paperwork step after each job
ideas.why: When you finish a job, the app says what's left for it (photos, invoice, affidavit) and opens it with one tap.

ideas.title: Which bids you win
ideas.why: Your win rate by borough and type of work, and the prices that won, so you know where to bid lower or higher.

ideas.title: Make the app open faster
ideas.why: Claude measures how long the map takes to open on a phone and speeds up the slow parts (jobs first, pictures later).

ideas.title: Weekly app check-up
ideas.why: Once a week Claude taps every button, reads the errors from your phone and fixes what's broken or slow, then tells you what it fixed.

ideas.title: End-of-day summary
ideas.why: At 6 PM the app tells you in a few lines what got done today, what is still waiting, and what tomorrow's route looks like.

ideas.title: One-hand mode
ideas.why: A switch that moves the main buttons to the bottom corner so you can reach everything with your thumb while holding tools.

ideas.title: Enough photos per job
ideas.why: The job card tells you when a job has before photos but no after photos (or the other way round) before you close it.
